## About
Baker Paint & Body Shop was started by Thomas J. Baker and is now operated by Ron Baker, Lucy Baker and Ron Baker Jr. We're a true family owned and operated business, and we've been serving the Pasadena area from our spot on E Walnut St for a long time.
We're dedicated to restoring your vehicle to pre accident condition using the highest craftsmanship and materials. Absolute customer satisfaction is our goal, whether it's a fender that came loose or a bumper that needs fresh paint.

## Services
- Autobody repair: Quality autobody repair in Pasadena.
- Restoring to pre accident condition: We restore your vehicle to pre accident condition using the highest craftsmanship and materials.
- Repainting: Hoods, mirrors, trunks and bumpers repainted.
- Scrapes and dents: Everyday scrapes and dents fixed.
- Paint matching: We match the paint and touch up small spots where it came off.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with the insurance side after an accident?
A: One reviewer said that dealing with insurance felt overwhelming, but we handled everything directly with State Farm. Give us a call and we'll talk through your situation.

Q: What should I keep in my car in case of an accident?
A: Print out our Accident scene info form. It has spaces for all the information you want to gather at the accident scene, and it's a must for everyone's glove box.

Q: Can I reach you after hours?
A: Yes. Leave us a message on our after hours voice mail at (626)793-7463 and we'll get back to you.

Q: Who runs the shop?
A: The Baker family. The shop is operated by Ron Baker, Lucy Baker and Ron Baker Jr.
